Mei Yamaguchi ( 山口 芽生 , Yamaguchi Mei ; born 14 June 1999) is a Japanese tennis player. Yamaguchi has a career-high singles ranking of 242 by the WTA , achieved on 5 May 2025, and a best WTA doubles ranking of 649, set in July 2021. [ 2 ] Yamaguchi made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2024 Toray Pan Pacific Open , losing to Bianca Andreescu in the first round.
